var TCBR={on:true,err:null,signs:new Map(),n:{sign:0,tile:0,lit:0,litDrawn:0,bus:0,wrap:0,plaque:0,rear:0,poster:0,shelters:0,hooks:0},drawn:{},lit:[],bus:null,busKey:'',

function tcbrErr(e){TCBR.err=TCBR.err||String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,300)}
const TCBR_BY_G7={},TCBR_BY_NAME={},TCBR_BY_SHOP={};
for(const k in TC_BRANDS){const b=TC_BRANDS[k];TCBR_BY_G7[b.g7]=k;TCBR_BY_NAME[b.name]=k;TCBR_BY_SHOP[b.shop]=k}


const TCBR_BY_PLACE={},TCBR_SIGNS=(how)=>{const o={};for(const k in TC_BRANDS)for(const s of TC_BRANDS[k].signs||[])if(s[0]===how&&s[1])o[s[1]]={k,ty:s[2]||null};return o};
